{{Quote|Look upon his face, then bring me the mask.|Meetra Surik to Visas Marr, referring to Darth Nihilus after his death|<ref name="TSL" />}}
The '''mask of Darth Nihilus''', or '''Mask of Nihilus''',<ref name="MarketSpecial">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170801|text=Cartel Market Specials: Week of August 1, 2017}}</ref> was one of the pieces of armor that [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] had bound to himself using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in an effort to retain a semblance of a physical form. Darth Nihilus had been one of the few who had survived the activation of the [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]] while on the surface of [[Malachor V]] during the last battle of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Battle of Malachor V]]. This experience left him with an insatiable need to [[Force drain/Legends|feed on the Force]]. Eventually this hunger began to erode his physical body and in an effort to keep himself alive, he bound his spirit to his armor, robes, and mask using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. At the end of the [[First Jedi Purge]] Nihilus was killed aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Ravager (Centurion-class)|''Ravager'']], by [[Meetra Surik]], his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Visas Marr]], and the current [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Canderous Ordo]], leaving his mask as a gruesome reminder of his reign as the ''Lord of Hunger''.

This mask was considered to be a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that encouraged the wearers to slowly destroy themselves for greater power. The lost mask of Darth Nihilus was imbued with potent dark side energy, allowing any who wore the ghost-white mask the power to wield the Force as if they were a Sith apprentice.

Later, the mask was recovered from the crashed smuggling ship, ''[[Nashuaga]]'', on the planet [[Volik]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Function==
Sometime between [[3960 BBY]]<ref name="KotORCG" /> and [[3952 BBY]]<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> the ravages of an insatiable [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] hunger for [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] destroyed [[Darth Nihilus]]'s physical body to the point where he was compelled to bind his life-force into his [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]]&mdash;including a facial mask&mdash;in order to avoid [[Death/Legends|death]] and give himself a palpable form which allowed him to wield a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and continue his [[Force power/Legends|mastery]] of the Force.<ref name="KotORCG" /> Darth Nihilus's mask continued to serve its purpose until his death at the hands of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] and her companions<ref name="TSL" /> in [[3951 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

For the next four thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]],<ref name="TURdate">''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' doesn't give a specific time as to when Darth Nihilus's mask is found on the planet [[Volik]]. However, the scenario does state that the mask was found in a cove beneath [[Mount Vorena]]. This mountain was named for the wife of former Jedi Master [[Dorin Se'ol]], who left the Jedi Order around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Therefore, it is assumed that the mask was not found at an earlier date.</ref> rumors spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] concerning the mask's power. It was said that the mask was invested with the dark side of the Force and if an individual who was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was to don the mask, that being would be able to wield the Force as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. If, however, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was to wear the mask, proficiency in additional Force powers&mdash;always including, but not limited to, dark side powers&mdash;were acquired. However, it was cautioned that the dark influence of the mask propelled the wearer towards acts of self-destruction in the pursuit of greater power.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the player character has an option to receive the Nihilus mask after his death through character dialog with Visas Marr. The player will then gain a bonus to their maximum Force points. The player cannot wear the mask, although it does show up in their inventory under "miscellaneous".

The mask of Nihilus (complete with accompanying hood) also appears in the MMO ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a headpiece that can be worn by any class. It can be found randomly in Crime Lord's Cartel Packs, purchased for Cartel Coins from the in-game market, or bought by player-created auction on the [[Galactic Trade Network]].

When working on the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', ''Star Wars'' author [[Abel G. Peña]] wrote a whole passage devoted to Nihilus' mask that was ultimately cut. It would have made up the last paragraph of Nihilus' section and mentioned that the mask may have been a [[Hendanyn death mask|death mask]] of [[Hendanyn]] make.<ref name="tfn">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50677352|board=Literature|thread=Obscure Droids and Ewoks comics -- translated by Abel Peña|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2013-04-27|time=01:11 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171105191827/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/obscure-droids-and-ewoks-comics-translated-by-abel-peña.50010980/page-3}}</ref> Those masks first appeared in ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', a [[1996]] novel written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
